criteria.statement: A successful trusted build result becomes exactly one canonical artifact without copying repository, tag, digest, or CI identifiers into the browser action.
The registrar binds service, build, service artifact repository, tag, and full sha256 manifest digest and verifies the tag resolves to that digest.
Mutable-only, tag/digest-mismatched, repository-mismatched, or unverifiable references produce no artifact.
Manifest verification provenance and available signature, SBOM, scan, policy, and CI evidence are persisted and visible on the Builds page.
Advanced manual artifact registration is disabled by default and is still subject to registry verification and canonical deduplication when enabled.
